criterion.name.exg-mis-partic-confl: Conflict of interest due to its participation in the procurement procedure
criterion.description.exg-mis-partic-con: The economic operator is aware of any conflict of interest due to its participation in the procurement procedure.
criterion.name.exg-mis-prep-confl: Direct or indirect involvement in the preparation of this procurement procedure
criterion.description.exg-mis-prep-confl: The economic operator or an undertaking related to it provided advice to  the buyer or otherwise has been involved in the preparation of the procurement procedure.
criterion.name.exg-mis-sanction: Early termination, damages, or other comparable sanctions
criterion.description.exg-mis-sanction: A prior contract with a buyer or a prior contract executed by the economic operator was terminated early, or damages or other comparable sanctions were imposed in connection with that prior contract.
question.label.exg-mis-sanction.QG1.QSG1: Have you taken measures to demonstrate your reliability (Self-Cleaning)?
criterion.name.exg-mis-misrepresent: Misrepresentation, withheld information, unable to provide required documents or obtained confidential information of this procedure
criterion.description.exg-mis-misreprese: The economic operator has been guilty of serious misrepresentation in supplying the information required for the verification of the absence of grounds for exclusion or the fulfilment of the selection criteria, it has withheld such information, it has not been able, without delay, to submit the supporting documents required by a buyer, or it has undertaken to unduly influence the decision making process of the buyer, to obtain confidential information that may confer upon it undue advantages in the procurement procedure or to negligently provide misleading information that may have a material influence on decisions concerning exclusion, selection or award.
criterion.name.exg-mis-unrel-sec: Lack of reliability to exclude risks to the security of the country
criterion.description.exg-mis-unrel-sec: The economic operator has been found based on any means of evidence, including protected data sources, not to possess the reliability necessary to exclude risks to the security of the country.
criterion.name.exg-natl-bre-nat-law: Breaching of obligations set under purely national exclusion grounds
criterion.description.exg-natl-bre-nat-l: The economic operator has breached its obligations set under purely national grounds of exclusion.
